acceptance: One-session runs use versioned query order, parameters, warmup, cache, repetition, and optional workload-gap policies.
A platform-specific cache-state procedure and verification evidence are recorded; an uncontrollable cold state is never claimed, and warm-only qualification is explicit.
Monotonic end-to-end timing includes planning, execution, and full result consumption; optional planning/execution/fetch components and non-overlapping setup/scored phase boundaries are recorded.
Every timing is joined to translated SQL, data state, oracle result, evidence status, and cohort identity.

The predeclared candidate set uses complete repetitions; an invalid repetition remains visible and invalidates the submission rather than being replaced selectively. Valid sets use median atomic measures and publish all runs and declared dispersion.
JOB and the qualified TPC-Havoc panel can run in Power while preserving canonical dataset and equivalence contracts.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. Numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, thresholds, and the M4 reference remain pilot hypotheses until methodology freeze.
description: Build deterministic one-session orchestration for the admitted Power workload. Reuse the run service, monotonic timing, result capture, validation, and manifest contracts; record full result consumption and diagnostics without altering official TPC paths.
